org.portico.impl.hla13.types

Class HLA13Region

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.hla13.types.HLA13Region
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hla.rti.Region, Serializable

    public class HLA13Region
extends Object
implements hla.rti.Region, Serializable
    This class represents a hla.rti.Region as defined in the HLA 1.3 spec. This class just wraps around an instance of RegionInstance (from the Portico object model types) and passes all requests on through to it.

      • toPorticoRegion

        public static RegionInstance toPorticoRegion(hla.rti.Region region)
                                      throws hla.rti.RegionNotKnown
        This method will take a region as the HLA1.3 type and attempt to convert and extract from it the wrapped RegionInstance. If there is a problem during this conversion (such as the method not being passed an instance of HLA13Region), an exception will be thrown.
        Throws:
        hla.rti.RegionNotKnown
